notes.title: Controller Support is HERE! 🎮 (+ Steam Trading Cards)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276411/76e99282d144da50b79230e571e4d91146100221.png"][/img][/p][p]Hello Slime Destroyers![/p][p]Remember when we said controller support would be out in early August? Yeah, about that. Turns out adapting an entire game to work properly with a gamepad was no small feat. 😅
 [/p][p]But the wait is over, we’re thrilled to announce full controller support! We’ve been playing with controllers ourselves, and honestly, we love it. We think you will too.
 [/p][p]This update also brings Steam Trading Cards! Along with them, you’ll find profile backgrounds, emotes, and other cool collectibles.
[/p][p]And finally, here are some extra tweaks and fixes not specifically related to controller support:[/p][p][/p][p]⚖️[b] BALANCE[/b][/p][list][*][p]Hardcore 4-2: Slightly easier now. After replaying as if we were new players, this stage was a bit harder than intended. We toned down enemy HP a little.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🎮 [b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b][/p][list][*][p]Snow event now explains its effects the first time it appears.[/p][/*][*][p]Thermometer tooltip improved for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Added “Hardcore” prefix on leaderboard for easier recognition on screenshots  (that's for you folks on Discord!).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]🛠️ [b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Various text tweaks across multiple languages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed vegetarian mode still showing meat in a few places (unacceptable!!!!).[/p][/*][*][p]Localized the lava shop “Back” button (previously English only).[/p][/*][*][p]Dropdown menus in settings now have a visual cue.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]20% OFF for a limited time, grab it while it lasts![/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Update on Steamdeck and Controller Support
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45276411/2c3749131afb5911b23437123932f19c9daef341.png"][/img]
Hello Islet Defenders! 🏝️[/p][p]We hope you're all having a wonderful day, protecting the kingdom and holding the castle![/p][p]We wanted to share that we’re currently working on making Islets Defense run smoothly on the Steam Deck, and alongside that, we're adding full controller support! 🎮[/p][p]Now, while this might sound like a simple task, it’s actually a bit tricky. Our game has a lot of mouse interactions that don’t easily translate to a controller, like hovering over currencies to read their descriptions, or placing buildings on a big grid. And since we’re just a team of three, we want to take our time and do it right, instead of dropping in a clunky “virtual mouse” solution.[/p][p]Now that the big round of launch bugfixes is behind us, we’ll be shifting full focus to this task. Our current goal is to wrap it up by late July or early August, but we’ll keep you posted if that changes![/p][p]That’s it for this short dev update, we hope you’re all enjoying your time defending your tiny islands. And hey, don’t forget to join our Discord to share your scores and chat with other defenders! It’s been super fun seeing a bit of friendly competition spark up there. 🔥[/p][p]Thanks so much for reading, and have a great day![/p][p]— Matheus Cunegato[/p][p]MiniGoof[/p]

notes.title: Patch v1.1.0 – Balance, QoL, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes: [p]What's up, Defenders! Today we are releasing version 1.1.0 of Islets Defense. [/p][p]Below you can check everything that was changed on this update:[/p][p][/p][p]⚖️ [b]BALANCE[/b][/p][list][*][p](Hardcore 1-1): Slightly easier now. While the stage was aligned with our expectations for Hardcore mode, its solution felt too narrow, with very few viable paths. We've tweaked it to reduce early frustration and better match the difficulty curve of other Forest stages.[/p][/*][*][p](Sea Stages): Overall a bit easier. When gathering food using a Fishing Market, tiles with fish now yield +5 food instead of +3. While not all players noticed this bonus, fish tend to appear where players naturally place markets — so this change should make food management smoother. We also adjusted some fish spawn points in stage 3-1 to make them more accessible.[/p][/*][*][p](Regular and Hardcore 3-3): These stages are now easier. They were a bit too challenging compared to the rest of the curve. The improved fish gathering also helps here, but we’ve made additional tweaks to ease the overall experience. [/p][/*][/list][p] 🎮 [b]QUALITY OF LIFE[/b] [/p][list][*][p]When you try to build or upgrade something but lack resources, the red warning icon now shows exactly how much of each resource you're missing — no need to open the resource window anymore.  [/p][/*][/list][p]🛠️ [b]FIXES[/b]  [/p][list][*][p](Stage 2-1): Fixed flickering enemy on the right side during the shooting minigame.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where defeating the last enemy with a spike could cause the game to soft-lock.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare soft-lock when morphing a tile and interacting with the level UI at the same time.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that prevented reading the thermometer tooltip in Snow stages while any interface (like upgrades or morph) was open.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minor text issues in French, Chinese, and Brazilian Portuguese.  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual bug where the Harvest Tree preview showed a wheat tile on Desert stages instead of a cactus. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a very specific bug that could open a black hole on Sea stages (yes, really).  [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some enemies weren’t dying even after reaching 0 HP.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Islets Defense is available now!
notes.notes:
[p][h2]The big day is here![/h2]
You can now play Islets Defense with a 10% launch discount! Check out our brand-new launch trailer below, along with a full list of everything we’ve prepared for this special day.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="uENlM8qSu9A;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]
[/b][h2]Steam Reviews: Your opinion matters![/h2]
We read every single review on Steam. If you play Islets Defense and want to share your thoughts, now’s the perfect time! Your review doesn’t need to be long or detailed, just a few words about what’s working, what feels off, or what stood out to you are more than enough. Your feedback helps shape future updates!

[h2]What’s in the game?[/h2]
◈ Over 30 unique structures, each with special abilities that offer distinct strategic possibilities.

◈ A 15-stage campaign across 5 handcrafted biomes, each bringing new gameplay twists and visual styles.

◈ Tons of upgrade options for your builds, encouraging experimentation and discovery.

◈ Hardcore versions of every stage, designed by hand to provide serious challenges for those who want more after beating the main campaign.

◈ A leaderboard system to compete with friends, full of depth for dedicated players.

◈ 10+ hours of gameplay, with high replayability for score-chasers and strategy lovers alike.

[h2]The adventure starts now![/h2]
We can’t wait to see you dive into Islets Defense. Have fun and enjoy the game! 

And if you'd like to connect directly with the developers, consider joining us on [url="https://discord.gg/UHutv7h2vK"]Discord[/url]!

With love,
The MiniGoof Team

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3235170/Islets_Defense/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Watch the Developer plays Islets Defense Demo!
notes.notes:
Watch our programmer, Will, take on Islets Defense, completing all three stages featured in the demo! Islets Defense is a turn-based tower defense game where you build a small village to gather resources and defend your castle. Carefully plan your actions, as each move brings the enemy waves closer! Strategize building placements and play your cards wisely, as timing and order are key.

⚠️ This is a pre-recorded stream!
